in_marathi.name: Ramji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means God Rama, an incarnation of Vishnu, and is a common name for boys in Hindu communities. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', which means 'pleasing to the senses, delighting, and delightful'.
